fixed_candidate.information_order: Use only completed H4 closes and act on the next executable session tick.
fixed_candidate.state: From 50 completed closes form 49 log returns. short_volatility is the sample standard deviation of the final 12 returns; past_volatility and long_volatility are both the sample standard deviation of the first 48 returns; horizon_return is log(close[49]/close[37]); strength is (short_volatility/long_volatility) * abs(horizon_return)/(past_volatility*sqrt(12)); sign follows horizon_return.
fixed_candidate.entry: When flat and abs(state) is at least 1.5, enter the opposite direction of the signed state at fixed 0.01 volume.
fixed_candidate.exit: Close when held at least 30 H4 bars, abs(state) is at most 0.6, or the current desired reversion direction opposes the held direction.
fixed_candidate.standalone_margin_gate: used margin plus required margin must not exceed 20 percent of current equity
fixed_candidate.durable_remaining_work: Preserve this identity unchanged.
